title: The Future of Truth — AI-Fabricated Quotes Incident
subtitle: Why does a book about AI-driven truth decay contain AI-fabricated quotes?
analyticQuestion: Why does a credentialed media-establishment book about AI-driven truth decay contain more than six AI-fabricated or misattributed quotes — and which hypothesis best explains the pattern of errors, editorial pipeline failure, and author's response framing?

keyJudgment.summary: The best-supported explanation is ordinary AI-assisted research negligence amplified by an editorial pipeline that treated high-status endorsements as a substitute for fact-checking (H1 + H4 in combination). Confidence: Moderate-to-High.

remainingGaps: Internal communications between author, editor, and publisher about manuscript review
Statements from endorsers about whether they fact-checked the manuscript
